rationale: Build on the staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline with a compact structural change instead of another flat scalar sweep. The fixed decoder-output anchor is strong locally, but it also forces every recurrent tail pass to pull against a stale reference. This edit adds tiny learned tail_anchor_gates so each recurrent block can refresh that anchor after its update, preserving the winning reverse-tail carry path while letting later recurrent passes hand off a cleaner anchor state. The new control tensors are tiny, stay in the existing fp32 keep path, keep shapes compile-stable, and directly target the still-promising anchor-refresh idea category without bloating the script or changing evaluation/export plumbing.
title: Learned Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh
